scope.question: Does the exact sealed BA3 identity channel tensorize to k independent disjoint lanes with a factorized polynomial-size proof-carrying representation?

lane_namespace.variable_map: V(i,j,v)=v+LANE_OFF(i,g)+BLOCK_OFF(j) for every frozen-U block variable v
lane_namespace.disjointness_requirement: For i!=h, variable sets of lanes i and h must be disjoint; no internal variable or endpoint variable is shared.
lane_namespace.metadata_variables: NONE: proof metadata is not a CNF variable and may not create primal-graph edges.

construction.uniformity: Construction is a closed formula in g,k,i,j and frozen BA3 offsets only; it may not depend on the transported vector b or holdout results.

expected_product_theorem.proof_method: componentwise Cartesian-product/disjoint-conjunction proof; explicit enumeration of 2^k boundary states is forbidden
expected_product_theorem.semantic_statement: For every b=(b_1,...,b_k) in {0,1}^k, output vector equals input vector componentwise.

information_accounting.N_direction_definition: number of pairwise distinguishable persistent boundary vectors
information_accounting.required_seal_sentence: EXPONENTIAL NUMBER OF SEMANTIC STATES != EXPONENTIAL REPRESENTATION SIZE WHEN THE RELATION FACTORIZES.

allowed: one BA3 lane schema plus k lane descriptors
forbidden: certificate records indexed by every b in {0,1}^k
certificate_contract.verification_strategy: verify lanes independently, verify namespace disjointness and absence of cross-lane clauses, then apply product theorem

source_preimage_and_reconstruction.frozen_witness_rule: For bit b_i choose a real sealed frozen-U witness with endpoint (q_i,p_i)=(b_i,1-b_i).
source_preimage_and_reconstruction.union_rule: Because lane variable sets and clauses are disjoint, the union of independently chosen lane witnesses must satisfy the full k-lane CNF.
source_preimage_and_reconstruction.constructive_return: Reconstruct every lane independently from a SAT model and then independently VERIFY the full original materialized k-lane generalized CNF.
source_preimage_and_reconstruction.vector_identity_requirement: q_{i,0}=q_{i,g-1} for every lane i; neither component may be replaced by TOP.

complexity_preregistration.encoded_input_note: If integer variable identifiers are serialized, encoded bit size additionally carries logarithmic identifier overhead; report it separately and do not conflate it with structural n.
complexity_preregistration.certificate_target: factorized s(g,k)=poly(g,k), with no factor 2^k; exact record count must be measured from the implemented certificate
complexity_preregistration.required_final_reexpression: Express s and total work t as polynomial bounds in total input size n, not only in separate g,k parameters.

width_preregistration.candidate_theorem: For a true disjoint union of k lane primal graphs, width(full)=max_i width(lane_i).
width_preregistration.promotion_rule: Candidate only until the actual shifted k-lane primal graph and explicit decomposition/elimination verifier are replayed.
required_checks: connected components equal k lane components
generic disjoint-union width proof from lane decomposition

holdout_plan.rule: Finite vectors are debugging/holdout evidence only. Generic product proof establishes all 2^k vectors. Do not enumerate all 2^k states for proof or certificate.

neutral_and_single_lane_recovery.k_equals_1: must recover exact sealed BA3 construction and semantics
neutral_and_single_lane_recovery.remove_lane_copies_except_one: must recover one exact BA3 lane

falsifiers.F2: Full relation is not the Cartesian product of lane relations.
falsifiers.F3: Some vector components merge after composition.
falsifiers.F6: Certificate requires explicit enumeration of 2^k states.
falsifiers.F7: Verification runtime becomes exponential in k.
falsifiers.F8: Actual width grows super-polynomially or violates the preregistered constant-width candidate without an accounted cause.
falsifiers.F9: Uniform construction depends on the transported vector or holdout-specific choices.
falsifiers.F10: k=1 or single-lane restriction fails to recover exact sealed BA3.

success_meaning_only: For arbitrary k and g, k independent Boolean boundary bits are transported exactly through arbitrary chain length using a proof-carrying factorized representation of polynomial size.
after_success: STOP. BA5 coupling experiment is not authorized by this handoff.
